thread:
emma (marketing): Hey team — finalizing the release blitz. Need quick confirmations so we can lock the announce window. Items: changelog link, docs deep-link, benchmark narrative blurb, webinar slot, and inbound lead routing. Can eng + docs give ETA? :rocket:
raj (eng): ETA on changelog diff and the canary rollout schedule — I can cut the changelog now, but want a short notes section about perf numbers. planning to freeze model pins by EOD.
emma (marketing): Awesome. For marketing we need: 1) permalink to the changelog entry 2) docs deep-link for 'getting started with dedicated' 3) 2-3 line benchmark narrative (p95 latency / tokens/sec) that we can quote 4) webinar date options (prefer week of May 20) 5) simple inbound routing: demo request -> sales queue A, enterprise leads -> AE team.
jordan (docs): I can push the docs deep-link. Will add an anchor like /docs/serve/dedicated#quickstart. ETA 4pm PT. Also can paste a short snippet for the release notes showing the API example.
raj (eng): For perf numbers — current canary shows p50=82ms, p95=160ms for 512-token samples on a single A10G-like instance, throughput ~1200 tok/s with batching. Those are stable across two runs. We should call out typical prompt length assumptions.
lina (product): Marketing: can you avoid absolute claims like "best" — stick to "up to" or "typical" phrasing. Also request a note about fallback routing to smaller models under high load.
nana-sales: Sales routing: can marketing confirm the exact form field name for 'deal size' so our intake filters work? Also we need the webinar registration tag to include 'release-2026-q2' so CRM funnels.
emma (marketing): Good call. We'll use form field 'estimated_arr' and tag 'release-2026-q2'. For messaging, we'll do: "Up to 2x throughput for typical long-chat workloads; p95 latency under 200ms on our dedicated config". Lina — happy to make that more conservative if you prefer.
lina (product): Tweak to "up to 1.8x throughput" and "p95 typically under 200ms". Also add a parenthetical: "measured on 512-token eval set; results vary by workload".
raj (eng): Updated perf blurb: "Measured on 512-token eval set (long chat); p50=82ms, p95≈160ms, throughput ~1200 tok/s; workloads vary." I'll paste the raw numbers into the changelog PR.
jordan (docs): Docs link ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/serve/dedicated#quickstart (permalink). I'm adding the API snippet and a note about rollout flags.
emma (marketing): Can eng drop the changelog permalink here once the PR is merged? We need it for the release post and the social thread. Also we need a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the blog and webinar slides.
raj (eng): Changlog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412 — should merge after QA. I'll ping again when merged. One-paragraph bench: "On typical long-chat workloads (512 tokens), our dedicated config shows median latency of 82ms and p95 under 200ms while delivering up to 1.8x throughput compared to baseline open checkpoints — measured with continuous batching and KV cache enabled." Thoughts?
emma (marketing): Nice. Shorten slightly for headline: "Up to 1.8x throughput on long-chat workloads; p95 typically under 200ms (512-token eval)." We'll expand in the blog.
lina (product): Good. Add a line in the longer blurb about 'graceful fallback to smaller model variants' so customers know about reliability.
raj (eng): I'll add fallback note to the changelog and docs.
nana-sales: Webinar slot: we have 3 options — May 21 10am PT, May 22 1pm PT, or May 27 11am PT. Which is marketing's pick? Also we need a registrant RSVP form mapping to the tag 'release-2026-q2'.
emma (marketing): Prefer May 21 10am PT. Can ops confirm calendar invite and Zoom account? I'll build the registrant page and map 'estimated_arr' field.
jordan (docs): I'll add a short 'what to expect in the webinar' bullets in docs and link to the signup from the welcome banner.
deploy-bot: scheduled release window: 2026-05-21T17:00Z -> 2026-05-21T18:00Z (canary->global over 1hr). See runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-2026-05-21
emma (marketing): Perfect — release window aligns with webinar timing (we'll run webinar earlier that day). Last ask: can eng/QA confirm there are no breaking admin API changes and share any ephemeral feature flags we should mention for early access?
raj (eng): No breaking admin API changes. Feature flags: dedicated-public-preview=true (expires 2026-06-01). Will list them in the changelog and drop a short note in the PR body.
emma (marketing): Great. I'll draft the announcement thread and social copy once changelog PR is merged. Jordan: please confirm docs link is stable after merge. Lina: I'll share the messaging draft for sign-off by EOD.
lina (product): I'll review the messaging by 5pm PT.
raj (eng): Changelog PR merged. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412/files — permalink to the entry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/8f3a2b7
emma (marketing): Copy that. Pulling commit link into the release post. Drafting social copy now, will ping for quick approvals. :thumbsup:
nana-sales: Thanks — we'll prep the demo queue and set up intake filter on 'estimated_arr'.
emma (marketing): Thanks all — staying in thread for final approvals. Will post the announcement at 2026-05-21T17:05Z after deploy-bot signals global done. :rocket:
